task.goal: Delete all my notes in Markor.
task.final_summary: I deleted all six notes in Markor's Documents/markor folder: the project team meeting notes, the weekly grocery list, the summer vacation plans, the art project sketches copy, the home renovation budget, and the fW01A backup. The Files list now shows only the ".." folder row with the empty-folder hint, so no notes are left.

steps.note: Launch Markor and read the note list
Map the Files list in Markor to inventory all notes
Check QuickNote tab contents for notes
Return to Files list to delete notes
Long-press first note row to open its context menu and find Delete
Confirm deletion of the first selected note
Confirm OK, then delete the remaining 5 notes one by one
Long-press grocery list row to start multi-select, then select remaining notes
Select remaining note rows in selection mode
Select art_project row, then budget and fW01A rows
Select budget row, then fW01A row, then Delete
Select fW01A row then tap Delete and confirm
Tap Delete for the 5 selected notes, then confirm OK
Confirm OK then verify with map_app levels 1
Recount the Files list with map_app levels 1 to confirm no notes remain, then done()
Task complete; all notes deleted and verified
